one_line: Name the parent's real problem in line one, over footage of the product already in use.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 handheld shot, a toddler with a pacifier beside a newborn on a mat. Voiceover (transcript): "ילדה בת שנתיים וילד בין חודשיים ואיך מחלקים את הזמן ביניהם?". Subtitles appear word by word from "בת".
q1_hook.why: A question only parents of a toddler and a newborn recognise, so the right viewer self-selects (H1). Voice and word-by-word text start together (H6). Cuts at 0:01 and 0:02 give early motion (E1). The narrator has no face (H4 not met) and the brand name comes just after 3 s.

beats.what: Toddler and newborn on the mat, three cuts; subtitles "בת", "בן", "מחלקים"
beats.why: The problem as a question, both children visible at once

beats.what: Cubes tumble, empty mat and foam steps, then the newborn on his tummy; "מוצרים", "שמעניקים"
beats.why: Shows the product first, then names it (brand spoken at 0:03, transcript)

beats.what: Toddler stacks cubes and jumps off foam pieces while the baby rests; "בו ולנו פשוט שקט"
beats.why: Both children busy in one frame: the promise shown, not told

beats.what: Toddler laughing on the mat; "בונה", "ופשוט יש", "שקט"
beats.why: A burst of joy gives the viewer a feeling to share

beats.what: A man sits on the mat and plays with the toddler; "שלי אני יכולה להגיד לכם רק דבר"
beats.why: A teaser line ("only one thing") just before the answer

beats.what: Toddler steps over foam pieces, then stacks cubes; "אחד אני כבר לא צריכה לחלק את"
beats.why: Answers the opening question in the narrator's own words

beats.what: The cube tower collapses; "אז למי שעדיין לא מכיר את", "הגיע הזמן", "שתכירו"
beats.why: A brand nudge placed after the payoff

beats.what: Toddler sits among the cubes; "נמצאים בתיאור"
beats.why: Points to the caption; the video stops on this frame

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: "תכתבו לי ואענה על הכל" (write to me, I will answer everything); "ובגלל ששאלתן אותי המון" says followers asked. No question, tag, save or send ask in the video or caption.
q2_flow.why: The opening question is answered at 0:22 to 0:26, so the loop opens and closes inside 31 s (H5, K2). A new shot about every 2 s keeps the picture moving (R3). 0:08 to 0:19 repeats the same "quiet" message (R3). About 5 s of brand nudge follow the payoff (R1).

q3_cta.what: Spoken at 0:29 (transcript) and shown at 0:30: "נמצאים בתיאור" (details are in the description). Also "הגיע הזמן שתכירו" at 0:27 to 0:29. Caption: "תכתבו לי ואענה על הכל"; "מגוון צבעים באתר"; last line "בשיתוף בליס".
q3_cta.why: Said and shown after the benefit, mid-frame and inside the safe zone (C6). But it is vague: no link, keyword or ordering step. The caption adds a second ask, write to her, so the actions are not one (C1).

q4_shown.what: From 0:00 the mat, foam steps and cubes are on screen with a toddler and a newborn using them. 0:20 a man plays with the toddler. Medium shot of cube stacking 0:25 to 0:29. No logo, price, sizes or packaging on screen.
q4_shown.why: The product is in use from the first frame and the narrator vouches first-hand (K5, S6). The laugh at 0:15 to 0:18 gives a feeling (K1). Sizes and materials are only in the caption (F4). Children's faces appear throughout, which LumeBook's own Reels must avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 14 shots in 31 s, about 2.2 s each, straight cuts, eight in the first 12 s. Word-by-word subtitles follow the voiceover; key words are bigger. No speed change seen. Ends on a held shot with "נמצאים בתיאור", no end card.
q5_edit.why: A cut every 1.5 s in the first 12 s, then longer shots, matches the moderate pace that holds attention (E1, E2). Synced chunks of one to three words keep the speech readable without a full transcript (E4, T2). Ends right after the last line, no dead tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: How a mother of a toddler and a newborn stops splitting her time: a foam play corner keeps both children busy. Serves parents of two who want calm at home.
q6_topic.why: The new-sibling worry is real and shared, told as a first-person confession (K6). A new baby is a buying moment for a play space (K7), though no gift or occasion is named. Laughter at 0:15 gives a positive peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Phone footage at home in daylight: handheld high-angle close shots for the hook and the laugh, propped static wide shots for cubes and climbing, static close-ups of the newborn on the mat. A man appears once. The narrator is never shown.
q7_filmed.why: Home footage in window light, full-screen vertical, reads as a real family, not an ad (H8, F7, F1). Wide shots make the product a backdrop, so no feature is readable at phone size (F4). Live motion throughout (F8).

q8_text.on_screen: Burned-in white sans subtitles, no box, centred at about 47 to 53% of the frame height, one to three words at a time, key words larger: "בת" (0:00), "מחלקים" (0:02), "את הזמן ביניהם?" (0:03), "שמעניקים" (0:05), "בו ולנו פשוט שקט" (0:08), "אחד אני כבר לא צריכה לחלק את" (0:23), "נמצאים בתיאור" (0:30). No headline card, brand text or price.
q8_text.caption: "שני קטנטנים בבית". About 150 words, no hashtags: a first-person confession, a three-product list (mat, 12 cubes, climbing set) with sizes and materials, "תכתבו לי ואענה על הכל", and "בשיתוף בליס" as the last line.
q8_text.why: Subtitles of most of the voiceover let a muted viewer follow (T1), in short chunks mid-frame, clear of the bottom 35% (T2, T4). White text on cream walls is low contrast at 0:04 and 0:28 (T5). The caption holds specs and product keywords, no hashtags (T7); the disclosure is last, below "more" (T8).

weak_points: Never shows what the products are or any feature; scripted ad line ("מוצרים מעוצבים שמעניקים", transcript); faded white subtitles on cream backgrounds; vague "in the description" CTA; disclosure only on the caption's last line; children's faces throughout.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on a parent line as subtitles over a propped phone shot of the book in use, hands only; answer it near the end, then point to the caption.
not_verified: Audio and music (cannot hear; the transcript holds only narration). Whether a subtitle shows the brand name at 0:03 to 0:04 (frames are one per second). Whether the narrator is the account owner (never on camera). Speed changes. Correction to src/coded: the subtitles read "ופשוט יש" then "שקט" (0:17 to 0:18), not "פשוט שקט בבית" as the machine transcript has it. Outfits change between shots, so the footage seems to come from several sessions. Media info shows paid-partnership label 0; the caption says "בשיתוף בליס".
